adapted_to: voiceprint agent decisions, not student grading

splits.validation: first 20 LibriSpeech test-clean speakers, used to compare embedders
splits.locked: next 20 test-clean speakers, reported separately and not used to choose an embedder

adoption_rule: Tier 1 redlines (security, redteam, tooling, response, flow) must pass 100%; on validation verify cases, paired bootstrap 95% lower bound must exceed 0, false-accept delta <= 0.02, and verify_all EER must not regress (> 1e-6). Locked split is never adopted.
primary_metric: verify accuracy (uncertain and missing decisions are incorrect) and verify_all EER

case_rules.probe: from a chapter the enrollment did not use whenever the speaker has one; single-chapter speakers are marked probe_session=same
case_rules.verify: balanced: one genuine and one impostor trial per speaker; this is the primary accuracy metric
case_rules.verify_impostor: every other speaker of the split claims the name; combined with verify for verify_all EER/minDCF
case_rules.robustness_noise: white, pink, and babble noise at SNR 20/10/5/0 dB (12 conditions x 40 trials); babble excludes trial target and impostor
case_rules.robustness_duration: clipped durations 1.0/1.5/3.0/5.0 s (4 conditions x 40 trials)
case_rules.robustness_channel: 8 kHz G.711 mu-law telephone channel (1 condition x 40 trials)
case_rules.robustness_reverb: exponential RIR at RT60 0.3/0.6 s (2 conditions x 40 trials)
case_rules.robustness_mixture: 5 two-speaker 8 kHz 0 dB mixtures evaluated via 分离再辨认
case_rules.uncertain: never counted as a correct automatic decision, in identification as in verification
